facts.fact: Reusable data-scope pattern found in MPT-SaaS app/Models/Scopes/UserScope.php: Eloquent global Scope that is FAIL-CLOSED (whereRaw('1 = 0') when no authenticated user) with a static withoutScope(callable) escape hatch that restores previous state in a finally block. This is the correct base for ERP data-scope authorization

Reusable modular-ERP pattern found in MPT-SaaS: Module model (key,name,icon,route,sort,is_core,min_plan) + UserModuleSetting (module_key,enabled,settings JSON) + ModuleKey enum + Plan enum with rank()/covers()/limits. Registry-driven module enable-disable with plan gating - directly applicable to the ERP modular requirement

facts.fact: SaaS-OMS proven pattern - THREE INDEPENDENT ORDER STATUS AXES (ADR-06): payment_status (unpaid/partially_paid/paid/refunded), fulfilment_status (new/allocated/picked/packed/shipped/delivered), exception_status (none/on_hold/cancelled/returned). Each enum owns allowedNext(); a cross-axis OrderStateMachine owns rules no single enum can know. Solves COD packed-but-unpaid and shipped-then-refunded without hybrid states. Status columns excluded from fillable; only the state machine writes them via forceFill inside DB::transaction
facts.source: Explore agent read SaaS-OMS app/Domain/Orders/OrderStateMachine.php, enums, migrations

facts.fact: SaaS-OMS proven tenancy pattern: single DB, row-scoped, NO package. TenantContext::idOrFail() THROWS when unresolved because returning null compiles to 'tenant_id IS NULL' and silently returns every unassigned row - throwing turns a data leak into a loud failure. BelongsToTenant auto-stamps on create, refuses cross-tenant creates, makes tenant_id immutable. Single greppable escape hatch Model::acrossTenants(). NO Gate::before super-admin bypass. Composite (tenant_id,id) FKs on 10 edges so the DB itself rejects cross-tenant references
facts.source: Explore agent read SaaS-OMS TenantContext, BelongsToTenant, TenantScope, BasePolicy, migration 2026_07_27_100001

facts.fact: BEST COMMISSION IDEA found (SAAS-Agent-Management-System): margin-as-commission. Direct commission = (buyer_price - upline_tier_price) * qty computed PER ORDER ITEM. The commission IS the price ladder, so no second rate to configure and no drift between pricing and commission. Also has the finest attribution grain of the three: order_item_id + source_user_id + approved_by on the commission row

VERIFIED 2026-08-15: Laravel's decimal:N cast returns a STRING at runtime (number_format output), not a float - confirmed by get_debug_type on ProductVariant::selling_price and TaxRate::rate_percent. Larastan's stubs type it as float, which produces false 'expects string, float given' errors at level 6. Money safety is intact; the fix is explicit (string) casts at the boundary plus a unit test asserting the cast returns a string, so a future framework change to float is caught rather than silently drifting money
facts.source: php -r get_debug_type probe against both models
